data.title: Home
data.hero_subcopy: Cassina, Moroso, and the makers architects trust — expert consultation and trade pricing for more than two decades.

children.text: A trusted partner to architects and interior designers who refuse to compromise on quality.

data.title: About
data.hero_subcopy: hive connects you with iconic manufacturers and the people who know every detail of the work.

children.text: For more than two decades, hive has been a trusted partner to architects and interior designers. We offer expert consultation, project quotes, and dedicated support by phone — alongside online trade pricing for immediate access to member benefits.
Visit us at Masko Mobilya Kenti in Başakşehir, or call (0212) 675 20 57 to speak with our staff.

data.title: Trade
data.hero_subcopy: Architects and designers get immediate access to member pricing, project quotes, and dedicated support.

children.text: Open a trade account to unlock online pricing across Cassina, Moroso, Flos, Herman Miller, and hundreds more manufacturers. Our team helps with specification, lead times, and project quotes — visit Masko Mobilya Kenti or call (0212) 675 20 57.

data.title: LC4 Chaise longue
data.summary: The iconic reclining chaise from Cassina’s Le Corbusier collection — continuous comfort in chrome and hide.

children.text: Designed in 1928 and produced by Cassina, the LC4 remains a definitive piece of modern seating — adjustable frame, sculptural silhouette, and materials meant to last.

data.title: Zig Zag Chair
data.summary: A continuous plane of wood folded into seating — Rietveld’s radical cantilever for Cassina.

children.text: Cassina’s Zig Zag is both structure and seat: no legs in the conventional sense, only a Z-shaped cantilever that still feels surprising a century on.

data.title: Gogan 3 Seater Sofa
data.summary: Soft geometry and generous proportions — Urquiola’s Gogan for Moroso.

children.text: Patricia Urquiola’s Gogan for Moroso balances humanistic comfort with a distinctive silhouette — a signature piece for residential and hospitality interiors.

data.title: Husk Armchair
data.summary: Layered cushions nested in a molded shell — Moroso’s Husk in its small armchair scale.

children.text: Husk pairs a molded shell with removable cushions — informal luxury that has become one of Moroso’s most recognized lounge forms.

data.title: Eames Lounge Chair
data.summary: Molded plywood and leather — the mid-century lounge that still defines the category.

children.text: Available through hive with trade support for specification and project orders.

data.title: Arco Floor Lamp
data.summary: Carrara marble base and a sweeping steel arc — Flos lighting at its most architectural.

children.text: A Flos classic: marble counterweight, stainless arc, and adjustable shade for dining and living spaces.
